_note: This Cessna exports its wings welded into the fuselage primitive, so 'remove the wing' has to be a cut rather than a node toggle. The control surfaces are separate nodes, but the classifier calls anything flat and spanwise a tail - the ailerons and flaps ride on the wing and have to go with it.

wing.comment: keeps the ~1.1 m cabin out of an 11.0 m span, and closes the box fore/aft and below so the cut takes the wing without the tailplane or the main gear legs
